shortDescription: Master times tables through magical adventures. Explore multiplication from 1 to 12 with friendly creatures, visual explanations and offline practice. No adverts or child accounts.
longDescription:
A little maths. A lot of magic.

Join Pip, a friendly dragon, on a journey to restore four magical islands. Solve multiplication challenges, gather sparks and bring the island crystals back to life.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY
Cast gentle number spells in Monster Math Battles. Open number locks in Treasure Hunt. Cross stepping stones in Times Table Jump. Power a little car in Multiplication Racing. Make equal scoops in Math Kitchen. Assemble a colourful companion in Build-a-Robot.

SEE WHY AN ANSWER WORKS
Explore tables from 1 to 12 with visual arrays, repeated addition, skip counting and fact-family explanations. When a question is tricky, a hint helps children see the groups. Untimed play gives them room to think.

A CONNECTED ADVENTURE
Complete five-challenge missions to restore crystals and earn mission badges. Later islands expand the table mix. Free practice lets children revisit any table from 1 to 12.

THOUGHTFUL PARENT CONTROLS
The protected parent area shows first-answer accuracy and practice progress by table. Learning records stay on the device and can be deleted. There are no mandatory child accounts, advertisements, subscriptions or social features.

FREE STARTER, OPTIONAL FULL ADVENTURE
Explore the starter meadow, the first three mission types and all multiplication tables for free. A one-time purchase in the parent area unlocks the remaining islands and mission types. The actual local price appears through Amazon.

DEVICE-DEPENDENT NARRATION
Written instructions and touch controls are always available. Spoken guidance requires a compatible installed offline TextToSpeech voice. Voice answering must only be advertised after validation on the relevant device and market.

Offline game content is bundled with the app. Purchasing and restoration require Amazon connectivity. Designed for children around 6–11; practice indicators are not a formal educational assessment.
